nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $n > 2$ and $\gcd(k, n) = 1$. Then the $\mathbb{Q}$-subalgebra of $\mathbb{R}$ generated by the real number $2\cos(2\pi k/n)$ has dimension $\varphi(n)/2$ as a vector space over $\mathbb{Q}$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function.
nodes.title: Lehmer's theorem on the degree of 2cos(2πk/n)

nodes.summary: Let $n > 2$ be a natural number, let $\psi_n$ be the real cyclotomic polynomial, let $\Phi_n \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ be the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial, and let $\varphi$ be Euler's totient function. Then in the ring $\mathbb{Z}[x, x^{-1}]$ of Laurent polynomials over $\mathbb{Z}$, $x^{\varphi(n)/2} \, \psi_n(x + x^{-1}) = \Phi_n(x)$, that is, $\psi_n(x + x^{-1}) = x^{-\varphi(n)/2} \, \Phi_n(x)$.
nodes.title: Lehmer's identity for the real cyclotomic polynomial

nodes.summary: For `2 < n`, `n.totient` is even and the `natDegree` of the real cyclotomic polynomial `realCyclotomicPolynomial n` equals `n.totient / 2`. The `Even` conjunct makes the source's exact half machine-visible under natural-number division.
nodes.title: Degree of the real cyclotomic polynomial

nodes.summary: For `2 < n`, `n.totient` is even and the `natDegree` of the real cyclotomic polynomial `realCyclotomicPolynomial n` equals `n.totient / 2`. The `Even` conjunct makes the source's exact half machine-visible under natural-number division.
nodes.title: Real cyclotomic polynomial has degree half the totient

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero, let $n > 2$ be a natural number, and let $\zeta \in K$ be a primitive $n$-th root of unity. Then the real cyclotomic polynomial $\psi_n$ equals the minimal polynomial of $\zeta + \zeta^{-1}$ over $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: The real cyclotomic polynomial is the minimal polynomial of $\zeta + \zeta^{-1}$

nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $n > 2$, $1 \le k \le n$ and $\gcd(k, n) = 1$. Then the real cyclotomic polynomial $\psi_n$ equals the minimal polynomial over $\mathbb{Z}$ of the complex number $2\cos(2\pi k/n)$.
nodes.title: Minimal polynomial of $2\cos(2\pi k/n)$ for $1 \le k \le n$ coprime to $n$

nodes.summary: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $n > 2$ and $\gcd(k, n) = 1$. Then the real cyclotomic polynomial $\psi_n$ equals the minimal polynomial over $\mathbb{Z}$ of the complex number $2\cos(2\pi k/n)$.
nodes.title: Minimal polynomial of $2\cos(2\pi k/n)$ for $k$ coprime to $n$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the real cyclotomic polynomial $\psi_n \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ is the minimal polynomial over $\mathbb{Z}$ of the complex number $\zeta + \zeta^{-1}$, where $\zeta = e^{2\pi i/n}$; for $n \ge 1$ this number is $2\cos(2\pi/n)$.
nodes.title: Real cyclotomic polynomial
